fusions.name: Sitting Bait
fusions.desc: Bars slam down around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second. Each has a 40% chance to be left [Pinned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Penning Splash
fusions.desc: Splashes water at a target that deals 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Decoy Pipe
fusions.desc: Sets a decoy at the nearest enemy with a cage trap behind it. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles springs it, which deals 20 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Behind the Bars
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
